title: Updating a Tape at a Word Position
statement: For Boolean words $\mathrm{pre}$ and $w$ and bits $b,b'$, overwrite the tape storing $\mathrm{pre}\mathbin{+}b\mathbin{+}w$ at cell $|\mathrm{pre}|$ with $b'$. The resulting tape is exactly the tape storing $\mathrm{pre}\mathbin{+}b'\mathbin{+}w$.
